shortDescription: Netherlands 10 Year Government Bond Yield increased to 3.38%, the highest since May 2011.Over the past 4 weeks, Netherlands 10Y Bond Yield gained 13.90 basis points, and in the last 12 months, it increased 44.71 basis points.
